title: Alcetas
summary: Raleigh names Alcetas in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Alcetas, the sonne of Alexander the Rich, slaine by Archelaus together with Alexander the sonne of this Alcetas. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book IV, Part I, Chapter I, §. I, sig. 460b
